mineagent.chat.messages.status: Chat history: %s messages; AI-name hover: %s (no extra prefix); thinking: %s
mineagent.chat.messages.mark: Hover over the AI name for date/time:
mineagent.chat.messages.help: Example: /ai msg mark Sent at: {yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} (date-format template, not a regex)
mineagent.chat.ended: This request has ended; no other request was interrupted.
mineagent.chat.queue_ended: This message has ended or is no longer queued. Nothing was resent or interrupted.

mineagent.chat.interrupted: Interrupted. Completed game or computer actions are not rolled back.

mineagent.activation.stale: This activation button has expired. Use /divzero_setup to choose again.
mineagent.activation.enabled: DivZero is enabled for you in this world. Press F2 now; no rejoin needed. Server permissions still apply.
mineagent.activation.disabled: DivZero is disabled for you in this world. Use /ai accept to enable it again.
mineagent.behavior.stopped: Stopped immediately; combat will not restart automatically.
mineagent.behavior.inventory: Waiting for inventory space for the drops.
mineagent.behavior.rod: Waiting for a usable fishing rod.
mineagent.behavior.loot_route: Drops are currently unreachable; a new pickup route is needed.
mineagent.behavior.defending: Threat detected. Defending before resuming work.
mineagent.behavior.resumed: Threats have cleared. Rechecking and resuming work.
mineagent.behavior.standby_failed: The task is complete; standby needs to be set again.
mineagent.behavior.contact_escape: Create distance, then resume hit-and-run combat.
mineagent.activation.bootstrap.starting: [DivZero] Enabling now. Stay in the world; it will be ready shortly.
mineagent.activation.bootstrap.failed: [DivZero] Could not enable: %s. Resolve this issue and retry /ai accept.
